Grandma's eyes sparkled today as baby Mia took her first wobbly steps right into her lap. We've been caring for her more lately, and this moment made all the late nights worth it. Family magic.
Celebrated Tom's promotion with a small cake at home. Dad, who's been weaker lately, raised his glass and toasted 'to my boy.' His smile was everything, feeling so grateful for these times.
Nana watched from his chair as little Priya graduated preschool. He clapped louder than anyone, even with his arthritis flaring. Such a proud moment for our joint family.
Sophie nailed her college acceptance! We gathered around Mom's bedside—she's recovering from a fall—and shared hugs. Her quiet 'I'm so proud' brought tears of joy.
Bhai got his promotion letter today! Mummyji made laddoos despite her back pain, and we all danced in the living room. Feeling that deep family bond.
Watching Grandpa light up as Ethan took first steps. He's been so frail, but today he laughed like a kid. Grateful for these simple joys amid caregiving.
Didi's graduation party was small, just us caring for Papa in the next room. Her speech mentioned him first—pure love and pride swelled in my heart.
Little Jack's first steps straight to Nana's arms! Nani video-called from India, her voice full of pride. Miss them, but so happy.
Promoted at work! Shared the news with Mom over tea—she's been my rock through her health struggles. Her hug said it all: pride and endless love.
Family cheered as baby took first steps, Grandma steadying herself to join in. Playful giggles filled the house, easing our daily care worries.
Riya's promotion calls for rakhi sweets next year! Dada danced with her, forgetting his cane. Such celebration in our home.
Grandpa beamed at Lily's graduation pics. We've been nursing his cough, but he insisted on framing them. Hope he's around for more.
